# Judd Fire Protection, LLC

> > Comprehensive fire protection and life safety services including sprinkler systems, fire alarms, and extinguishers for residential and commercial properties across the Mid-Atlantic region.

Judd Fire Protection, LLC is a full-service fire safety company serving Maryland, Virginia, Pennsylvania, Delaware, and West Virginia with NICET-certified professionals. They specialize in design, installation, inspection, and maintenance of fire protection systems for both residential and commercial clients.

- Fire Sprinkler Systems

## Core Services

- [Sprinkler Systems](https://www.juddfire.com/sprinkler-systems): Overview of sprinkler system design, installation, and maintenance services including wet-pipe, dry-pipe, and deluge systems.
- [Fire Alarms](https://www.juddfire.com/fire-alarms): Fire alarm installation, monitoring, inspection, and 24/7 emergency service across the Mid-Atlantic.
- [Fire Extinguishers](https://www.juddfire.com/fire-extinguishers): Fire extinguisher installation, maintenance, and inspection services across Maryland and Virginia.

## Service Solutions

- [Design & Build](https://www.juddfire.com/design-build): Fire sprinkler system design and build services including custom engineering and system planning.
- [Installation](https://www.juddfire.com/installation): Professional installation services for sprinkler systems, alarms, and fire extinguishers with expert engineering.
- [Inspection & Testing](https://www.juddfire.com/inspection): Fire sprinkler, alarm, and extinguisher inspection and testing across Baltimore, Maryland, Virginia, Pennsylvania, and Delaware.
- [Service & Maintenance](https://www.juddfire.com/service-maintenance): Fire safety equipment service, maintenance, and emergency response compliance services.

## Market Segments

- [Commercial Fire Protection](https://www.juddfire.com/commercial): Commercial fire protection systems and services for businesses in Baltimore and surrounding Mid-Atlantic areas.
- [Residential Fire Protection](https://www.juddfire.com/residential): Residential fire sprinkler installation, maintenance, and home safety solutions for families.
